text:
Some personal review of faculties that I did courses with in my BBA (for the juniors): 
MKT202 aws- teaching style is ok but too rude and marking is not that well. Questions are easy but lengthy
MKT202: afh: book porte hobe, questions are easy. U can take him and study book to understand concepts. 
ACT201 and 202- rhf (ruhaini fatema Mam) she is very strict but very knowledgeable, her practice maths are easy and that comes in the exam as well.
Bus172: mhm sir. Very knowledgeable, teaches extremely well. But grading is not very good. Even if u feel that u will try, u just can’t get over B that easily.A simple mistake in maths (plus minus sign or decimal places) will get ur entire 10 marks cut.Exam questions are tricky to understand, very lengthy exam.
Bus173: KNI sir. Unfortunately, he is no more.
Eco101: sif. Mam is very strict, marks are hard to score. She is very knowledgeable. Just read her slides and be attentive in class. A- is a must then.
Eng103: ssy. She is the best! Sakiba ferdousy miss! Just follow the class, B + is easy to get
Pbh101: hrh sir. A bit boring but everything comes exactly from slides. If u can write at least 80% as slides, u get the full marks. suggestions are given. exam e he will tell u when u r stuck at any point.
Env107: kbu. Just slide based. English speech delivery is very poor. But getting A is damn easy.
Mis105: fhm. Onk onk easy going. Slides porlei hoy. Book porte hoy na. Suggestion diye dei. Easily A pawa jay
Eco104: apk, she is not organised. Cannot teach well but tries very hard. Vocal is not loud and a student may struggle. She is a NSU graduate. 
Fin254: SNT. Well she is a sweetheart. Maths are easy, can teach well. Helps u during exam and questions r easy. Avg B+ grading.
Mgt210: Neh mam. Just as pretty she is...very strict as well. Must read book to get A or A-. Slides are enough to get B/B+...
Bus251: SQT. Class e he is very helpful but exam paper checking e he is damn strict. Grading system is poor. Questions are average but students find it struggling to do a course with him. Onek marks kate. Book must be followed to do good.
Mis205: NIZ. any student is lucky to get NIZ sir. Onekkkk easy going. Questions are from slides. Suggestion diye dei. Curve kore grade.
Mkt337: tmt. Onek strict, teaches well. Must follow his lectures. Mcq and questions are conceptual. Must do a good report, the grade depends entirely on it. I think 60% marks were on report!
Mkt344 and MKT460: mbt sir. Vocal is low. Hard to hear Sir. Sir is very very very easy going and a cool faculty. Slides are short and following slides can help u get full marks in MCQ. Use examples for conceptual questions. Easy A! Project is important for MKT460
Psy101: sfk/skf: miss is very strict. Unnecessary strict! To get an A, reading the book is a must. But for a GED COURSE, she is too much to handle.
Eng105: shafqat sir (forgot initial). Biased. Teaching method: Avg. questions are based on the book. But he is gender biased....(honestly said)
Mgt321 and MGT489: ZMU mam. She is the best. Most easy going. No words to explain. Reading the book will get u an easy A. Following slides are enough as well. Questions are very easy, if u r attentive in class, u can get a grade curved. Mgt489 e report onk important and SPSS lage.
Mkt465: ztk. Just dont take her (girls!)
PHI401: krl. Eto easy going bolar baire! Questions are straight from slides. If u can write as it is (or a bit modified) he will give an average of 19/20 to all the students who attempted in the exam.
Inb372: fss sir. He is easy going.questions are easy and direct from slides..scrapbook expectations are high so u lose marks there. Exam paper e conceptual questions e, he cuts lot of marks! Avg grade B-/B
Mgt351: mhw sir left. No comments. 
Pad201: slk mam. Everything are from slides. Questions are extremely easy. Suggestions are given. Easy A...
Law200: afr2/arf2
Anika Mam.she is a good person and helpful too. No matter how much u try, u will end up with B- or B. Must memorize from book. Positive: sections and numbers are not focused on.
Mgt368: mfw. Easy going. Less needed to study. b+ average grade
Phi101 and 104: mnt sir. So boring but everything comes from slide. Easy to get A. 
Mat112: KMZ Sir. Board e ja math korabe tai i ashbe but bujhaite mone hoy tar koshto hoy 
 bhalo poray na. 
Mat112: Sic: he has mental issues. Cannot behave properly. Maths bujhaite pare na. 100 marks er exam ney, and unnecessarily ekta simple mistake e full marks kete dey. Plz dont take him. Tar system e math na korle full marks kete dibe and decimal places er jonno o full marks chole jabe.
Eco244: CNQ. A pretty and well behaved faculty. Poray khub i bhalo. Ja porabe tai i dibe but Book theke question ashe, but somehow the final exam results are bad of most of the students. Avg grade- B/B+
Eco134: SNS. Easy going. Class e ja maths korabe oitai exam e dibe. Practice sums dey. Onek chances dey bhalo korar.
Mgt314: jms mam. No extra comments. Try kore bujhanor onek; but ekhono bujlam na, she lacks or we lack. But i think she tries her best. Strict ektu. Grading avg B/B-. 
Pol104: MR. Just drop. Avg grade B. Tar slides likleo kom marks dey. Conceptual question o kore. I dont think ei level er course er jonno eto conceptual and internet ghatano dorkar.
MKT412: fhz. Onek bhalo ekta manush Ma’m.she will try her best to help u, attentive hole qnd lecture follow korle book pora lagbe na.MCQ 30-50 ta dey, few are a bit tricky and some are conceptual. Project is important and A is possible.
HIS101: mab2. Onek porte hobe!!! Slides are huge, internet o ghatate hobe. Mcq slides theke ashe but dates and all ashe, khub tricky. Score kora tough. But question answer e bhalo korle A guaranteed and he curves as well.
Mkt470: TMR. He cannot be reviewed! Extremely knowledgeable and teaches outstanding! Concept pura clear hoye jay. Slides are easy and mcqs are conceptual. Project is important, SPSS lage ei course, i think tar theke better and eto easily keo bujhabe na. Spss mid or quiz e dey na...book pora lage na. See less
